About Stitchery

Craftsmanship built on trust, precision and partnership

Stitchery is a professional uniform manufacturing and tailoring house, trusted by schools, corporates, and defense & security institutions for consistent quality at scale. Every garment that leaves our workshop is a product of precision tailoring, premium materials, and a stitching discipline refined over years of institutional work.

We specialise in bulk manufacturing without compromising on comfort or durability — building long-term partnerships with the institutions we serve, order after order, season after season.
